notes.label: Sketchfab
use_for: rigged character references when the avatar builder output is too primitive
environment reference models for Louvre, bakery, library, and house rebuilds
replacement props when hand-built low-poly placeholders block interaction testing
notes.intake_rule: Copy useful downloads into Assets/third_party/intake with a manifest, smoke-test imports in Blender, and preserve originals until Robert approves cleanup.
notes.caution: Use downloaded models as references or staged bodies first; avoid destructive mesh merging until rig, scale, materials, and licensing notes are checked.
